HEURISTIC RANKING - no usable KNIME usage counters exist for this workspace. KNIME's usage statistics file (C:\Users\chusm\knime-workspace\.metadata\knime\nodeusage_3.0.json) exists but its 'nodestats.nodes' array is empty and it records workflowsOpened=0, launches=6 over 15562400 ms of uptime: no workflow was ever opened through the GUI, so no per-node counter was ever written. Eclipse .prefs files and combined-preferences.epf were also searched; they contain no node usage keys.
Score = 1000 x (node instances in the user's own KNIME projects, excluding the bundled Example Workflows; 290 instances over 37 distinct factories) + 25 x (instances in KNIME's bundled Example Workflows: 182 instances over 75 factories) + curated bonus 1000 -> 100 decayed by position in a 186-entry list of well-known KNIME nodes (all 186 matched an installed node, covering 185 distinct factories) + top-level category weight 20..200. Ties break on (full_category_path, name, factory).
Node names that appear more than once in the candidate pool (KNIME ships legacy variants sharing a display name with their modern replacement, e.g. two CSV Readers) are collapsed to one entry, keeping the active, non-hidden, best-scoring declaration; that is why the list contains no deprecated or hidden nodes.
Caveats: no usage numbers are real except the workspace instance counts, which measure how often a node was *placed in a workflow*, not how often it was executed. Node names come from real settings.xml records where available and are otherwise derived from the factory class name ('name_source' marks which). KNIME 5.x plugin.xml declares no <name>, <fullCategoryPath> or <shortDescription>, so 'description' is empty for every node and 'full_category_path' is resolved from the repository category tree; 71 nodes declare no category-path at all and are listed as 'Uncategorized'.
